description: Get the direct children of a Sitecore item by its ID, with all their fields. Pass options.fields to return only the fields you need — the full form is roughly 1.9KB per child.

fields.description: Return only these fields on each item. Set it whenever you know what you need — a full item carries every field of its template, roughly 1.9KB each.

name: item-service-get-item-children
